951: ਮਲੁ ਕੂੜੀ. ਨਾਮਿ ਉਤਾਰੀਅਨੁ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
Through the Name he has washed off the filth of falsehood; chanting the Name he has become a dealer in Truth.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਹਿ; ਸੋ ਜੀਵਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak: may the Giver, whose wonders these are, live forever over us. ॥2॥
ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
There is no giver as great as You, O Lord; of whom could we say it?
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇ; ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
By the Guru's grace the nectar is obtained, from whom ego departs.
ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਾਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
He is beyond all tastes and flavours; true is His glory.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ; ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
He gives it to whom He forgives, and Himself unites him with Himself.
ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਈ ॥੯॥
He has placed the nectar within every heart, but gives it to drink through the Guru to some rare one. ॥9॥
The stories of the Guru turn sons into worthy sons;
ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ; ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
they accept what pleases the True Guru, and do such deeds.
ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ, ਬਿਆਸ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ; ਬਚਨ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Go and ask the Simritis and Shastras, Vyaas, Suk and Narad, who teach the whole world.
ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥
Those whom the True One attaches are attached to the True One, and ever dwell on the True One.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਏ; ਜਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, approved is their coming into the world; they save all their generations. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ; ਸਿਖ ਭੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Those whose guru is blind, the disciples too act blindly.
ਓਇ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ; ਨਿਤ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੇਨਿ ॥
They walk by their own will and ever speak falsehood upon falsehood.
ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ; ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
They practise falsehood and deceit, and ever slander others.
ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ; ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇਨਿ ॥
Slandering others, they drown themselves and drown all their generations.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਤੁ ਓਇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ; ਉਇ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak, they are attached to what He attaches them; what can the poor wretches do? ॥2॥
ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ; ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
He keeps under His gaze all the creation He has made.
ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ॥
Some He has attached to falsehood and deceit; the self-willed are ruined.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ॥
Those turned to the Guru ever meditate on Him, with love for the Lord within.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨੑ ਵਾਤਿ ਸਿਪੀਤੀ ॥
Those with merit in their account have His praise on their lips.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਚੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Nanak, meditate on the Name; His praise alone is true. ॥10॥
The so-called righteous commit sin and pretend to practise virtue;
the so-called gurus go to disciples' homes to give instruction for gain;
the wife loves her husband only for what he earns;
otherwise he may come or go as he pleases.
No one heeds the Shastras or Vedas;
Becoming a qazi, one sits to dispense justice;
he tells his rosary beads and calls on God,
but taking bribes he denies people their rights,
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪੁਛੈ; ਤਾ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
and if anyone questions him, he reads out some text.
The rulers' orders fill the ears and hearts of the Hindu leaders;
they have the people plundered and inform on them.
One who purifies his cooking square thinks himself pure —
The yogi, a householder, wears matted hair and ashes,
while his children cry before and behind him.
He has not found yoga, and has lost the way of living.
Why has he put ashes on his head?
Nanak, this is the mark of the Dark Age:
each is his own leader and his own praiser. ॥1॥
The Brahmin comes into the Hindu's home,
recites mantras and places the sacred thread around his neck.
Wearing the thread, the man still does evil;
by bathing and washing he is not accepted.
952: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ; ਕੋ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
but without following the Guru and Pir, no one is accepted.
Many ask the way to heaven, but rare is the one who goes there;
without good deeds, heaven is not attained.
One asks the way at the yogi's camp,
and for that wears earrings in his ears.
Wearing earrings he wanders the world,
As many beings as there are, all are travellers;
when the summons comes, there is no delay.
One who knows Him here recognises Him there;
all else is empty talk, whether Hindu or Muslim.
The account of all is taken in His Court;
without good deeds, no one crosses over.
One who chants the Truest of the True,
Nanak, is not called to account hereafter. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੁ ॥
The body is called the Lord's temple, a fortress and stronghold.
ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੁ ॥
Within are rubies and jewels; through the Guru, recite the Lord's Name.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ, ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜੁ ॥
The body, the Lord's temple, becomes most beautiful when the Lord's Name is implanted within.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਤ ਕੜੁ ॥
The self-willed He Himself has led astray; attachment to Maya ever torments them.
ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
The One Master is the Master of all; He is found by perfect destiny. ॥11॥
ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ. ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ; ਨਾ ਸਤਿ. ਪਾਣੀ ਜੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
Spiritual success is not in suffering, nor in comfort, nor in standing in water — countless creatures live in water.
ਨਾ ਸਤਿ. ਮੂੰਡ ਮੁਡਾਈ ਕੇਸੀ; ਨਾ ਸਤਿ. ਪੜਿਆ ਦੇਸ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
It is not in shaving the head, nor in wandering through lands as a learned debater.
ਨਾ ਸਤਿ. ਰੁਖੀ ਬਿਰਖੀ ਪਥਰ; ਆਪੁ ਤਛਾਵਹਿ. ਦੁਖ ਸਹਹਿ ॥
It is not in trees and stones, which let themselves be hacked and suffer pain.
ਨਾ ਸਤਿ. ਹਸਤੀ ਬਧੇ ਸੰਗਲ; ਨਾ ਸਤਿ. ਗਾਈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ॥
It is not in being bound by chains — elephants are chained — nor in grazing on grass like cows.
ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਸਿਧਿ. ਦੇਵੈ ਜੇ ਸੋਈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
He in whose hands success lies gives it; it comes to the one to whom He gives it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ॥
Nanak, glory comes to the one within whose heart the Word abides.
ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਮੇਰੇ. ਹਉ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਜਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
(The Lord says:) "All hearts are Mine, and I am in all; who can instruct the one I lead astray?
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਾ ਵਾਟੜੀ; ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
Who can mislead the one to whom I show the path?
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਸਿਰਿ; ਤਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੧॥
Who can show the path to the one I lead astray at the very start of the journey?" ॥1॥
He alone is a householder who restrains his senses,
who begs for chanting, austerity and self-discipline,
and whose body is given to merit and charity;
such a householder is as pure as the water of the Ganges.
If Ishar the yogi chanted the True Lord in this way,
ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ; ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
he would merge in the Supreme Essence, without form or feature. ॥2॥
He alone is a true ascetic who burns away self-conceit,
who makes his torment the alms he consumes,
who begs alms of the Lord within the city of the heart;
such an ascetic ascends to the Lord's realm.
If Gorakh chanted the True Lord in this way,
ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ; ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
he would merge in the Supreme Essence, without form or feature. ॥3॥
He alone is a true Udasi who cherishes detachment,
who sees the Immaculate Lord dwelling above and below,
and joins the moon and sun, peace and wisdom, within;
ਤਿਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਾ; ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
the wall of that Udasi's body does not collapse into vice.
If Gopi Chand chanted the True Lord in this way,
ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ; ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੪॥
he would merge in the Supreme Essence, without form or feature. ॥4॥
He alone is a true "unbeliever" who washes the body clean of sin,
who kindles the divine Light within his body,
and does not yield to lust even in dreams;
953: such a one is not touched by old age or death.
If Charpat chanted the True Lord in this way,
ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ; ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੫॥
he would merge in the Supreme Essence, without form or feature. ॥5॥
He alone is a true Bairagi who turns the Lord toward his own heart,
who raises the pillar of the Name in the tenth gate,
and night and day remains in meditation within;
such Bairagis become like the True One.
If Bharthari chanted the True Lord in this way,
ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ; ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੬॥
he would merge in the Supreme Essence, without form or feature. ॥6॥
ਕਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ; ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
How is evil to die, and how is true life to be found?
What is gained by piercing the ears and eating the sweetened bread?
The One Name alone exists, whether the world exists or not.
ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਿਆਉ ॥
What is that Word in which the heart remains fixed? It is the Name.
ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ; ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
If one bears sunshine and shade, pain and pleasure, alike,
ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
then, Nanak says, he truly keeps the Guru in mind.
The disciples of the Naths, busy only with the six garbs,
One who remains absorbed in the Formless Lord —
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
That alone is called the Lord's temple in which the Lord is known.
ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ. ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
In the human body, through the Guru's words, He is found, and the all-pervading Lord is recognised.
ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਖੋਜੀਐ; ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Do not search for Him outside at all; the Creator is within the home of the body.
ਮਨਮੁਖ. ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ, ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
The self-willed do not appreciate the Lord's temple; they waste away their lives.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
The One Lord pervades all, but He is found through the Guru's Word. ॥12॥
ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੈ; ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ॥
Only a fool listens to a fool's words.
ਮੂਰਖ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਖਣ ਹੈ; ਕਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
What are the marks of a fool? What does a fool do?
ਮੂਰਖੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ; ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
A fool is one who is beguiled by Maya and dies spiritually in ego.
ਏਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ; ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Acting so, there is ever pain; he lives in pain.
ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਵੈ ਖੂਹਿ; ਕਿਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
One who loves Maya too much falls into the well; what can be done to save him?
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ; ਓਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
One who turns to the Guru reflects on this and remains detached.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੈ; ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਭੀ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Chanting the Lord's Name he saves himself, and those drowning behind him are carried across too.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak, He does whatever pleases Him; whatever He gives must be endured. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ; ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਿਖ ਸਹੀ ॥
Nanak says: O mind, listen to the true teaching.
ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ; ਬੈਠਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਹੀ ॥
God will sit with the ledger open and call you to account.
ਤਲਬਾ ਪਉਸਨਿ ਆਕੀਆ; ਬਾਕੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹੀ ॥
The rebellious ones with balances outstanding will be summoned.
Azrael, the angel of death, will stand ready over them.
ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਭੀੜੀ ਗਲੀ ਫਹੀ ॥
Trapped in that narrow lane, the soul will see no way to come or go.
ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਓੜਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੨॥
Nanak, the false are defeated; in the end only Truth prevails. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
The whole world is the Lord's body; the Lord Himself pervades all.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
His worth cannot be estimated; nothing can be said of it.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
By the Guru's grace one praises the Lord and is dyed in His devotion.
ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ; ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
Mind and body blossom, and ego is dispelled.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
Everything is the Lord's play; through the Guru He makes a rare one understand. ॥13॥
Gautam made Indra weep with the punishment of a thousand marks;
Parasraam wept on returning home, stripped of his power;
King Ajai wept when he had to eat the alms he had given;
such is the punishment received from the Lord's Court.
Rama wept when he was exiled,
954: and Sita and Lakhshman were separated from him.
he who carried off Sita disguised as a mendicant with a drum.
The Pandavas wept when they became servants,
though Krishna, their master, dwelt beside them.
through one mistake he remained a sinner.
lest they suffer at the last moment.
Kings weep when they become yogis with pierced ears,
and go begging from door to door.
The miser weeps when the wealth he hoarded goes;
the pandit weeps for lack of wisdom;
the young wife weeps when she has no husband.
Nanak, the whole world is in pain.
One who believes in the Name departs victorious;
no other deeds are of any account. ॥1॥
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਨਿਐ; ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Chanting, austerity and all are contained in believing in the Name; all other deeds are useless.
ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak, the one who believes is honoured; this is understood by the Guru's grace. ॥2॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ; ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The union of body and soul was written by the Creator from the beginning.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
He pervades all, hidden; through the Guru He is revealed.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ; ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
One who sings and utters His praises merges in His virtues.
ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Through the true bani one becomes true; the Guru unites him with the True One.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੪॥
He Himself is everything, and He Himself bestows glory. ॥14॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਰਤਨਾ ਪਰਖਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
Nanak, if a blind man goes to appraise jewels,
ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਆਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
he does not know their worth, and only exposes himself. ॥1॥
ਰਤਨਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਥਲੀ; ਰਤਨੀ ਖੋਲੀ ਆਇ ॥
The Guru, the jeweller, has come and opened the bag of jewels of the Lord's virtues.
ਵਖਰ ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ; ਦੁਹਾ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
It is cherished by both the seller and the buyer.
ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਮਾਣਕ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
Nanak, those with virtue in their laps trade in these rubies;
ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਅੰਧੇ ਵਤਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
those who do not know the worth of the jewels wander blind in the world. ॥2॥
ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ; ਦਸਵੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
The body is a fortress with nine gates; the tenth is kept hidden.
ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ. ਨ ਖੁਲਨੀ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
Its rigid doors do not open; they are opened only by the Guru's Word.
ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਜਦੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
The unstruck instruments resound; they are heard through the Guru's Word.
ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
Within that heart there is light; through devotion one meets the Lord.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
The One who fashioned the creation pervades all. ॥15॥
ਅੰਧੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਦਸਿਐ; ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
If a blind man shows the way, only one who is blind will follow it.
ਹੋਇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Nanak, one who can see — how could he be led astray?
ਅੰਧੇ ਏਹਿ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਇਣ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Those are not called blind who have no eyes in their face;
ਅੰਧੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਖਸਮਹੁ. ਘੁਥੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, they alone are blind who stray away from their Master. ॥1॥
ਸਾਹਿਬਿ. ਅੰਧਾ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ; ਕਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
One whom the Master has made blind sees only if He makes him see.
ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ; ਜੇ ਸਉ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
He acts as he understands, though one may tell him a hundred times.
ਜਿਥੈ ਸੁ ਵਸਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪਈ; ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਉ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
Where the true thing is not recognised, know that self-conceit holds sway.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗਾਹਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ; ਸਕੈ ਨ. ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak, how can the buyer purchase what he cannot recognise? ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜਿ ਹੁਕਮਹੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
How can one be called blind who is made blind by His Command?
ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੁਝਈ; ਅੰਧਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Nanak, he is called blind who does not understand His Command. ॥3॥
955: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਗੜੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
Within the body is the Lord's fortress and stronghold; He is in all lands and countries.
ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
He Himself sits in deep trance, having entered into all.
ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ; ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੇਸਾ ॥
He Himself fashioned the creation, and Himself keeps Himself hidden in it.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਏਸਾ ॥
Through serving the Guru He is known, and the True One is revealed.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Everything is the Truest of the True; the Guru has given this understanding. ॥16॥
ਸਾਵਣੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਹਾੜੁ ਦਿਹੁ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਖੇਤ ॥
The night is the summer crop and the day the winter crop; lust and anger are the two fields.
ਲਬੁ ਵਤ੍ਰ, ਦਰੋਗੁ ਬੀਉ; ਹਾਲੀ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਹੇਤ ॥
Greed prepares the soil, falsehood is the seed, and attachment is the ploughman and farmer.
ਹਲੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ, ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਣ; ਹੁਕਮੀ ਖਟੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
Thought of vice is the plough, and vice the harvest heap; by His Command one eats what one has earned.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ; ਅਉਤੁ ਜਣੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, when the account is called for, the father departs as if childless, his life wasted. ॥1॥
ਭਉ ਭੁਇ. ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਣੀ; ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਲੇਦ ॥
Let the fear of God be the field, pure conduct the water, truth and contentment the oxen,
ਹਲੁ ਹਲੇਮੀ, ਹਾਲੀ ਚਿਤੁ; ਚੇਤਾ ਵਤ੍ਰ. ਵਖਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
humility the plough, the mind the ploughman, remembrance the moist soil, and union with the Guru the time of sowing;
ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੁ. ਬਖਸੀਸ ਬੋਹਲ; ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਦਰੋਗ ॥
let the Name be the seed; then the harvest of His grace is gathered, and the whole world is seen as false.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ; ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
Nanak, when He casts His gracious glance, all separation ends. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Within the self-willed is the pitch darkness of attachment; he speaks in love of duality.
ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਤ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥
In duality there is ever pain; he churns water forever.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੋਲੈ ॥
The one turned to the Guru meditates on the Name; churning, he draws out the essence.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਟੋਲੈ ॥
His heart is illumined and there is light within; searching, he has found the Lord.
ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
The Lord Himself leads astray in doubt; nothing can be said of it. ॥17॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥
Nanak, do not be anxious; He Himself takes care.
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ; ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
He created creatures in the water, and gives them sustenance too.
ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ. ਨ ਚਲਈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
No shop runs there, and no one farms there;
ਸਉਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ. ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
no trade is done, and no one buys or sells.
ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ; ਖਾਣਾ ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
He has made beings the food of beings.
ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਾਇਰਾ; ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Those He created in the oceans, He cares for too.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, do not be anxious; He Himself takes care. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ; ਝੀਵਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Nanak, this soul is a fish, and craving, bringing spiritual death, is the fisherman.
ਮਨੂਆ ਅੰਧੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਈ; ਪੜੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
The blind mind does not remember the Lord, and unawares the net falls upon it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਚਿਤੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Nanak, the mind is heedless, bound by anxiety.
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ; ਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
If He casts His glance, He Himself unites it with Himself. ॥2॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ ॥
True forever are those who have drunk the Lord's sublime essence.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
Through the Guru the True One dwells in their minds; they have made the true bargain.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੈ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
Everything is within the home of the heart; the fortunate have obtained it.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਤਾ ॥
Craving within has died, singing the Lord's praises.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
He Himself has united them in union; He Himself gives understanding. ॥18॥

cut into pieces, it is boiled for washing;

the scissors cut it, the tailor tears it, and needle and thread sew it up.

So, Nanak, torn honour is sewn up through the Lord's praise, and one lives a true life.
ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਾਟੈ; ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਗੰਢੈ ॥
The cloth grows old and tears; the needle and thread mend it,
ਮਾਹੁ ਪਖੁ. ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੰਢੈ ॥
but it does not last a month or a fortnight, only an hour or so.

Nanak, the Master is the Truest of the true; this is known only when we remember Him. ॥1॥

and, Nanak, at His door he merges in His vision. ॥2॥

but do not be proud, Nanak, lest you fall headlong. ॥3॥
ਸੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
One who walks the Guru's way joins the true company and is united with the Word.
ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
Those who have the Lord's wealth as their provisions meditate on the True One and become true.
ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ. ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦੇ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੈ ॥
The devotees look beautiful singing His praises; through the Guru's teaching they become steady.
ਰਤਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਲੈ ॥
Through the Guru's sublime Word, reflection on the jewel of the Name dwells in their minds.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
He Himself unites them with Himself, and Himself bestows glory. ॥19॥
ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ; ਕੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Everyone is caught in hope; rare is the one free of hope.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ; ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, one who dies to hope and lives in Him — blessed is his coming. ॥1॥
ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸਾ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ; ਕੇਉ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Hope has no power of its own, yet no one can free himself of it.
ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ; ਜਾਂ ਭੋੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
What can poor hope do, when the Lord Himself leads astray? ॥2॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ; ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
Cursed is life in the world without the True Name.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
God is the Giver of all gifts; this wealth of the Name is everlasting.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ; ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
Pure is the one who worships Him with every breath.
With your tongue chant the One, the Knower of hearts, the Unreachable.
ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤਿ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
Nanak is a sacrifice to Him who pervades all. ॥20॥
ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸ. ਧੁਰੇ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ; ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
The union of the pool and the swan is from the beginning; so it pleases the Master.
ਸਰਵਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ; ਸੋ ਹੰਸਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
In the pool are diamonds and pearls; they are the swans' food.
ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗੁ. ਨ ਰਹਈ ਸਰਵਰਿ; ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
The heron and the crow cannot remain at the pool, however clever they may be;
ਓਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ. ਨ ਪਇਓ ਓਥੈ; ਓਨੑਾ ਹੋਰੋ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
their food is not there; their food is something else.
ਸਚਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਚੋ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
By practising Truth the True One is found; false is the pride in falsehood.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪੈਯਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru who have the warrant from the Lord's Court. ॥1॥
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਉਜਲਾ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
My Master is pure; whoever keeps Him in mind becomes pure.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ॥
Nanak, serve the One who gives forever and ever.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ. ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Nanak, serve the One by whose service pain departs,
ਅਵਗੁਣ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
faults are removed, virtues take their place, and peace comes to dwell in the mind. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਆਪਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
He Himself pervades all; He Himself sits in deep trance.
He Himself gives instruction; through the Guru He has convinced the world.
ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ; ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ॥
Some He has led into the wilderness; some He has attached to devotion.
ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ; ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
Only the one He makes understand understands; He Himself attaches people to the Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
Nanak, meditate on the Name; this is true glory. ॥21॥1॥ Sudh
957: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੈਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ; ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਡੀਠੁ ॥
As I had heard of the True Guru, so have I seen him.
ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
He is the emissary of the Lord's Court, who reunites the separated with God.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ; ਕਟੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
He implants the mantra of the Lord's Name and cures the disease of ego.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak, God unites with the True Guru those for whom such union is written from the beginning. ॥1॥
ਇਕੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ; ਇਕੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
If the One is a friend, all are friends; if the One is an enemy, all are at odds.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
The Perfect Guru has shown that without the Name all is useless.
ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਭਰਮਿਆ; ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
The wicked faithless, attached to the taste of duality, wander lost.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak has come to know the Lord God by the grace of the True Guru. ॥2॥
The Builder Himself built this structure of the world.
ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥
He Himself is the perfect banker, and Himself earns the profit.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ; ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
He Himself spread out the expanse, and Himself is imbued in its colours.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ. ਨ ਪਾਇ; ਅਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਟਿਆ ॥
The worth of the creation of the Unseen Lord cannot be estimated.
He is unreachable, unfathomable, infinite, the farthest of the far.
He Himself is the great King, and He Himself the counsellor.
ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੀਮ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਟਿਆ ॥
No one knows His worth, or how great His seat is.
He Himself is the True Master; He is revealed through the Guru. ॥1॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰਿਆ; ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
Listen, my beloved Friend: show me the True Guru.
ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
I shall give him my mind and keep him ever enshrined in my heart.
ਇਕਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Without the One True Guru, cursed is life in this world.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ; ਜਿਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Servant Nanak: He has united with the True Guru those with whom He ever abides. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ; ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
Within me is the longing to meet You; how can I find You, O God?
ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ; ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
Find me such a friend who will unite me with my Beloved.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ; ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
The Perfect Guru has united me; wherever I look, there He is.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak serves that God; there is no other as great as He. ॥2॥
With what mouth can the Great Giver be praised?
ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ; ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੀਐ ॥
Those He protects in His mercy He provides with sustenance.
ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਸਿ; ਸਭਨਾ ਇਕ ਧਰ ॥
No one is in anyone else's power; all have the One support.
ਪਾਲੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗਿ; ਦੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰ ॥
He Himself nurtures all like children, giving them His hand.
ਕਰਦਾ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ; ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
He stages His joyful plays; nothing of them can be understood.
ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ; ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
I am a sacrifice to Him, the all-powerful Support of all.
Sing night and day of the One worthy of being sung.
ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ; ਤਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
Those who fall at the Guru's feet enjoy the Lord's sublime essence. ॥2॥
ਭੀੜਹੁ ਮੋਕਲਾਈ ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ; ਸਭ ਰਖੇ ਕੁਟੰਬੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
He has freed you from distress and protected you along with all your family;
ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਾਲਿ ॥
He Himself has resolved your affairs; ever cherish that God.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਦਾ; ਲਹੁੜੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
Like mother and father, God hugs us close and nurtures us as little children.
ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
Nanak, all beings become kind to the one on whom the Lord casts His gracious glance. ॥1॥
958: ਵਿਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ. ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ; ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
To ask for anything other than You is to invite the worst of pains.
ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
Give me Your Name and make me content, that the hunger of my mind may be satisfied.
ਗੁਰਿ. ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਆ ਮਨੁਖ ॥੨॥
Nanak, the Guru has made even the forest and grass green; what then of human beings? ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ; ਮਨਹੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
Never forget such a Giver from the mind;
ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਨਾ ਸਰੈ ॥
without Him one cannot pass even an hour, a moment or an instant at ease.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੁਕਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
He is within and without, with us; what can anyone do in secret?
ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ; ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
The one whose honour He Himself preserves crosses the world-ocean.
ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
He alone is a devotee, wise and austere, on whom He shows mercy.
ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
He alone is perfect and honoured whom He blesses with strength.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ; ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ॥
He alone endures the unendurable whom the Lord Himself helps to endure it.
ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ. ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥੩॥
He alone meets the True One who enshrines the Guru's teaching in his mind. ॥3॥
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੜੇ; ਆਲਾਪਤ ਸਭ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
Blessed are those beautiful melodies, singing which all thirst departs.
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਦੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
Blessed are those beautiful beings who, through the Guru, chant the Name.
ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ. ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am forever a sacrifice to those who worship the One single-mindedly.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਛਦੇ; ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
I long for the dust of their feet; it is obtained by His grace.
ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਕੈ; ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who are dyed in the love of Gobind.
ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਇ ॥
I tell them the pain of my soul: unite me with the Lord, my Friend and King.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
The one whom the Perfect Guru has united is rid of the pain of birth and death.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ; ਅਨਤ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Servant Nanak has found the Unreachable Lord, and goes nowhere else. ॥1॥
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਧੰਨੁ; ਧਨੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Blessed is that time, blessed that hour, blessed that moment and that sublime instant;
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੜਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
blessed is that day and that union in which I beheld the Guru's vision.
ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
The desires of my mind are fulfilled; I have found the Unreachable, Infinite Lord.
ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟਾ ਮੋਹੜਾ; ਇਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Ego is shattered and wretched attachment is gone; the One True Name is my support.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ਹਰਿ; ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak is attached to the Lord's service, through which the whole world is saved. ॥2॥
To a rare few He has given His praise and devotion.
ਸਉਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪੁਛ. ਨ ਲੀਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
Those to whom He entrusts these treasures are not called to account again.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ; ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
Those whom His love touches are dyed in His love.
ਓਨਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ; ਇਕਾ ਉਨ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
The One Name is their support; the One Name is their food.
Following them, the world eats and enjoys.
They love God, and God yields to their love.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ; ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
The one whom the Guru comes to meet comes to know God.
ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ; ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
I am a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to their Master. ॥4॥
ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
My friendship is with the One Lord alone; my love is for the One Lord alone.
ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੋ; ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
The One Lord is my true friend; my companionship is with the One Lord alone.
ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਗੋਸਟੇ; ਮੁਹੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
My conversation is with the One Lord alone; He never frowns or turns His face away.
ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ; ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਮੋੜੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
He knows the state of my soul, and never rebuffs my love.
ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਸਲਤੀ; ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
The One Lord is my counsellor, all-powerful to destroy and create.
ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਿਆ ਜਗ ਹਥੁ ॥
The One Lord is my Giver; His hand is over the heads of all the world's givers.
ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ. ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਜੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
I take the support of the One Lord alone, who is all-powerful over all.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ॥
Placing his hand on my forehead, the True Guru has united me with the Lord, the Saint.
959: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
The Guru has united me with the Great Master, who has saved the whole world.
ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ; ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
The desires of the mind are fulfilled for the one who has such union destined from the beginning.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
Nanak, he has found the True Name and ever enjoys its bliss. ॥1॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
Friendship with the self-willed is a relationship only for Maya.
ਵੇਖਦਿਆ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਨਿ; ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
As we watch, they run away; they never form a lasting bond.
ਜਿਚਰੁ ਪੈਨਨਿ ਖਾਵਨੑੇ; ਤਿਚਰੁ ਰਖਨਿ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
As long as they get food and clothing, they keep the tie;
ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥
on the day they get nothing, they start speaking harshly.
ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
The blind, ignorant self-willed know nothing of the soul.
ਕੂੜਾ ਗੰਢੁ. ਨ ਚਲਈ; ਚਿਕੜਿ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
A false bond does not last, like a dam of stones bound with mud.
ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟਨਿ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
The blind do not know themselves; they beat their breasts in empty worldly affairs.
ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ; ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹੰਧੁ ॥
Entangled in false attachment, they pass their lives crying "I, I."
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ; ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
The one on whom He shows mercy, He blesses fully from the beginning;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ; ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥
servant Nanak: those who seek the True Guru's refuge are saved. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ; ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
Those dyed in His vision are truly His own.
ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ; ਕਿਉ ਲਭੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
Those who know the Master — how may one obtain the dust of their feet?
ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ; ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
The filthy, corrupt mind becomes pure in their company.
ਦਿਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ; ਖੁਲੈ ਭਰਮ ਤਾਕੁ ॥
The true mansion is seen, and the door of doubt is opened.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਧਾਕੁ ॥
One to whom He shows His mansion is never pushed away.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ; ਬਿੰਦਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਝਾਕੁ ॥
With even a glimpse of His gracious glance, mind and body are enraptured.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Attach yourself to the Guru's Word, and find the Name, the nine treasures.
ਤਿਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਖਾਕੁ; ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੫॥
He alone obtains the dust of the saints' feet who has such destiny on his forehead. ॥5॥
ਹਰਣਾਖੀ ਕੂ. ਸਚੁ ਵੈਣੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ; ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
O doe-eyed one, I tell you a true word that will save you.
ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਚਨ. ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਛਬੀਲੀ; ਪਿਰੁ. ਤੈਡਾ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
Listen to these beautiful words, O lovely one: your Husband is the support of your mind.
ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ. ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ; ਦਸਿ ਵਿਖਾ. ਮੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ॥
You have fallen in love with the wicked; tell me, let me see, why is it so?
ਊਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ. ਝੂਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
You lack nothing, you are not deficient, you are without nothing,
ਪਿਰੁ ਛੈਲੁ ਛਬੀਲਾ. ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਓ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
yet, unfortunate and evil-minded, you have abandoned and lost your handsome Husband.
ਨਾ ਹਉ ਭੁਲੀ. ਨਾ ਹਉ ਚੁਕੀ; ਨਾ ਮੈ. ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸਾ ॥
(Bride:) "I have not strayed, I have not erred, nor am I at fault;
ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਾਈ. ਤਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਗੀ; ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
as He attached me, so am I attached; listen to this true message.
ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਾਗਣਿ; ਜੈ ਪਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
She alone is the happy bride, she alone fortunate, on whom the Husband has shown His mercy.
ਪਿਰਿ. ਅਉਗਣ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ; ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
The Husband has removed all her faults, and hugging her close, has adorned her.
ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ; ਕਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
I, the unfortunate bride, pray: Nanak, when will my turn come?
ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ; ਇਕ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
All the happy brides enjoy their bliss; O Lord, grant me too one night." ॥1॥
ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਡੋਲਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Why do you waver, O mind? The Lord is the Fulfiller of hopes.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ; ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being, who dispels all pain.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਮਨ; ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
O mind, worship the Lord's Name, and all sins and vices will depart.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Those with such destiny written from the past are imbued with love for the Formless Lord.
ਓਨੀ ਛਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਵੜਾ; ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
They have given up the wretched taste of Maya and gathered the wealth of the Infinite Name.
ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਇਕਤੈ ਲਿਵੈ; ਮੰਨੇਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Through all eight watches they are attuned to the One, and obey the Command of the Infinite.
960: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ; ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak begs for one gift: grant me Your vision and love in my mind. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ॥
The one in whose mind You come to dwell, O Lord, has lasting peace.
ਜਿਸੁ. ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ. ਨਾਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
The one in whose mind You come to dwell has no pain from Death.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿ ਕਾੜਿਆ ॥
The one in whose mind You come to dwell — what anxiety can he have?
ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ; ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
The one whose friend is the Creator has all his affairs resolved.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਨੁ ॥
The one in whose mind You come to dwell is approved.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਬਹੁਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
The one in whose mind You come to dwell has great wealth.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਸੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
The one in whose mind You come to dwell has a great family.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੬॥
The one in whose mind You come to dwell saves his generations. ॥6॥
ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ. ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ; ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Blind within and blind without, he sings falsely, falsely;
ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਏ; ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
he washes his body and draws ritual marks, yet runs greatly after Maya.
ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
The filth of ego within is not removed, and he comes and goes again and again.
ਨੀਂਦ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ. ਕਾਮਿ ਸੰਤਾਪਿਆ; ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Overcome by sleep and tormented by lust, he utters "Hari, Hari" with his mouth.
ਬੈਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ; ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
He calls himself a Vaishnav, but his deeds bind him in ego; what can he gain by threshing husks?
ਹੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਠਾ. ਬਗੁ, ਨ ਬਣਈ; ਨਿਤ ਬੈਠਾ. ਮਛੀ ਨੋ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Sitting among swans, the heron does not become a swan; even there he keeps watching for fish.
ਜਾ ਹੰਸ ਸਭਾ, ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਨਿ; ਤਾ ਬਗਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
When the gathering of swans reflects and looks, they find no fit with the herons.
ਹੰਸਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਣਾ; ਬਗੁ ਡਡਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
The swans feed on diamonds and pearls; the heron goes searching for frogs.
ਉਡਰਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਬਗੁਲਾ; ਮਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ, ਮੰਞੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥
The poor heron flies away, lest his secret be exposed.
ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ; ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਦਿਚੈ. ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Each is attached to what he is attached to; whom can we blame, when it pleases the Lord so?
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ. ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
The True Guru is a pool overflowing with jewels; whoever is destined receives them.
ਸਿਖ ਹੰਸ. ਸਰਵਰਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਏ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
By the True Guru's Command, the Sikh-swans gather at the pool.
ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ; ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ. ਤੋਟਿ, ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
The pool overflows with jewels, gems and rubies; they eat and spend them, yet they never run short.
ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ; ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
The swan does not leave the pool; so it pleases the Creator.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ. ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Servant Nanak: the Sikh with such destiny written on his forehead comes to the Guru;
ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ; ਸਭਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
he himself is saved, saves all his family, and liberates the whole world. ॥1॥
ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਖਾਏ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ; ਕੋਰੜ ਮੋਠ ਜਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
He calls himself a pandit for his learning in many paths, but he is like a hard bean that will not soften.
ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹੁ. ਨਿਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਤਿਸਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਦੇਹਾ ॥
Within him is attachment; he is ever gripped by doubt, and his body does not rest.
ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ. ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
His coming and going are false; he is ever eyeing Maya.
ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਤਾ ਛੋਹੋ ਆਵੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਹਾ ॥
If someone speaks the truth, he is irritated; within him is great anger.
ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕੁਮੂੜਾ; ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
He is a great fool, gripped by evil-mindedness and bad intellect; his mind clings to attachment.
ਠਗੈ ਸੇਤੀ. ਠਗੁ ਰਲਿ ਆਇਆ; ਸਾਥੁ ਭਿ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
A cheat joins with a cheat; the two make a well-matched company.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ, ਨਦਰੀ ਵਿਚਦੋ ਕਢੈ; ਤਾਂ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਇਆ ਲੋਹਾ ॥
When the True Guru, the assayer, examines with his glance, the iron is exposed.
ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਥਾਈ ਰਲਾਇ ਰਲਾਇ ਦਿਤਾ; ਉਘੜਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਅਗੈ ਆਇ ਖਲੋਹਾ ॥
Though it be mixed in with others in many places, its veil is lifted and it stands exposed.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਵੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ. ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥
If he comes to the True Guru's refuge, he is turned from rusted iron into gold.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ, ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ; ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟੇ, ਕਰੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
The True Guru has no enmity; son and enemy are alike to him; cutting away faults, he purifies the body.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
Nanak, the one with such destiny written on his forehead loves the True Guru.
